t4577.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAzra ibn Yaḥyā, who transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and from whom Qatāda transmitted, acceptable, of the sixth generation; identified in al-Bayhaqī's narration, affirmed by Abū ʿAlī al-Naysābūrī.

t4681.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAlqama b. Qays b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Nakhaʿī al-Kūfī as trustworthy, firm, a jurist and worshipper, of the second generation, who died after the sixties, it is said after the seventies.
as: Trustworthy, firm, a jurist and worshipper.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
عثمان بن سعيد, quoted by al-Mizzī
كلاهما ثقتان وعلقمة أعلم بعبد الله
Both he and ʿAbīdah are trustworthy, and ʿAlqamah knew Ibn Masʿūd better.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
وأعلم الناس بعبد الله علقمة، والأسود، وعبيدة، والحارث
He counted ʿAlqamah among those who knew Ibn Masʿūd best.
ʿAlqamah was the closest of the group to Ibn Masʿūd.
ثم علقمة الثالث لا شك فيه
In the Kūfans’ ranking, ʿAlqamah was unquestionably third.
ʿAlqamah was among the learned and devout.
He preferred ʿAlqamah over al-Aswad and mentioned that he fought at Ṣiffīn.
قوموا بنا إلى أشبه الناس بعبد الله هديا ودلا وسمتا
He called ʿAlqamah the closest to Ibn Masʿūd in conduct, bearing, and manner.
ما أقرأ شيئا ولا أعلمه إلا علقمة يقرأه أو يعلمه
I recite or teach nothing that ʿAlqamah does not recite or teach.
Yes, by God, he is the best reciter among you.
إن كان أهل بيت خلقوا للجنة، فهم أهل هذا البيت علقمة والأسود
If any household was created for Paradise, it is this one: Alqamah and al-Aswad.
ابن معين, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان علقمة أعلم بعبد الله- يعني من عبيدة السلماني
ʿAlqamah knew Ibn Masʿūd better than ʿAbīdah al-Salmānī did.
أبو معمر, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
كان أشبه الناس بعبد الله سمتا وهديا
He most closely resembled Ibn Masʿūd in bearing and conduct.
مرة الهمداني, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ʿAlqamah was among the learned and devout.
Ibn Masʿūd, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما أقرأ شيئا ولا أعلمه إلا وعلقمة يقرؤه ويعلمه
I recite or teach nothing that ʿAlqamah does not recite and teach.
عمرو بن شرحبيل, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
انطلقوا بنا إلى أشبه الناس هديا وسمتا بعبد الله
He called ʿAlqamah the closest to Ibn Masʿūd in conduct and bearing.
ʿAlqamah was among the learned and devout.
He was trustworthy and transmitted many hadiths.
He preferred ʿAlqamah and mentioned his presence at Ṣiffīn.
سألت إبراهيم عن علقمة والأسود أيهما كان أفضل قال: علقمة
Asked which was better, Alqamah or al-Aswad, Ibrahim said Alqamah.

t5787.bio: Ibn Ḥajar calls Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Hudhalī al-Baṣrī, known as Ghandar, reliable and sound in his book though somewhat heedless, of the ninth generation, died in year ninety-three or ninety-four.
as: ثقة صحيح الكتاب إلا أن فيه غفلة
Reliable, sound in his book, except that he had some heedlessness.
أحسبه من بلادته كان يفعل هذا!
I think he did this (submitting every note back to Shuʿbah) out of dullness.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان من أصح الناس كتابا، وأراد بعضهم أن يخطئه فلم يقدر عليه
He had one of the soundest written records; some tried to find an error in it and could not.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
هو أحب إلي من عبد الرحمن في شعبة
For Shuʿbah he is dearer to me than ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (ibn Mahdī).
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كنا نستفيد من كتب غندر في حياة شعبة
We benefited from Ghundar's books in Shuʿbah's lifetime.
He called him 'the one with the sound book'.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Ghundar is firmer than I in Shuʿbah's hadith.
عبد الله بن المبارك, quoted by al-Mizzī
إذا اختلف الناس في حديث شعبة فكتاب غندر حكم بينهم
When people differ over Shuʿbah's hadith, Ghundar's book judges between them.
كان من خيار عباد الله على غفلة فيه
He was among the best of God's servants, despite some inattentiveness.

t7086.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Nāfiʿ, Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Madanī, client of Ibn ʿUmar, as trustworthy, firmly established and a well-known jurist, of the third generation, who died in 117 AH or later.
as: Trustworthy, firmly established, a well-known jurist.
He was reliable and prolific in hadith.
أصح الأسانيد: مالك، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر
The soundest chain is Mālik from Nāfiʿ from Ibn ʿUmar.
Mālik ibn Anas, quoted by al-Mizzī
كنت إذا سمعت من نافع يحدث عن ابن عمر لا أبالي أن لا أسمعه من غيره
When I heard Nāfiʿ from Ibn ʿUmar I did not care to hear it from anyone else.
عبيد الله بن عمر, quoted by al-Mizzī
God has favoured us with Nāfiʿ.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Trustworthy (Nāfiʿ and ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār); he did not prefer one, nor between Nāfiʿ and Sālim.
وسالم أجل من نافع، وأحاديث نافع الثلاثة أولى بالصواب
Sālim is greater than Nāfiʿ, but in the three hadiths where they differ Nāfiʿ's versions are more likely correct.
He was reliable and prolific in hadith.
أي حديث أوثق من حديث نافع
What hadith is more reliable than Nāfiʿ's hadith?
نافع بن أبو نعيم, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
إذا أخبرك أحد أن أحدا من أهل الدنيا قرأ عليه نافع. فلا تصدقه كان ألحن من ذلك
Do not believe anyone who says Nāfiʿ read to him; he made too many grammatical errors for that.
كنا نرد نافعا عن اللحن فيأبى
We would correct Nāfiʿ's grammatical errors and he refused.
